paragraphs: The following description of the business of Sunrise Realty Trust, Inc. should be read in conjunction with the information included elsewhere in this Annual Report on Form 10-K for the year ended December 31, 2025.
Unless the context otherwise requires, the terms "Company," "SUNS," "we," "us," or "our" refers to Sunrise Realty Trust, Inc.

SUNS is a Maryland corporation that was formed on August 28, 2023, that elected to be treated as a real estate investment trust for U.S. federal income tax purposes for its taxable year ended December 31, 2024, and made its first investment in January 2024. SUNS is an integral part of the platform of affiliated asset managers under the Tannenbaum Capital Group ("TCG"). We are led by a veteran team of commercial real estate investment professionals and our external manager, Sunrise Manager LLC (our "Manager"), which, alongside other TCG platform asset managers pursuing similar or adjacent opportunities, are supported by the marketing, reporting, legal and other non-investment support services provided by the team of professionals within the TCG platform. Our and our Manager's relationship with TCG provide us with investment opportunities through a robust relationship network of commercial real estate owners, operators and related businesses as well as significant back-office personnel to assist in management of loans.

Our focus is on originating and investing in secured commercial real estate ("CRE") loans and providing capital to high-quality borrowers and sponsors with transitional business plans collateralized by CRE assets with opportunities for near-term value creation, as well as recapitalization opportunities. SUNS intends to further diversify its investment portfolio, targeting investments in senior mortgage loans, mezzanine loans, B-notes, commercial mortgage-backed securities ("CMBS") and debt-like preferred equity securities across CRE asset classes. We intend for SUNS' investment mix to include loans secured by high quality residential (including multi-family, condominiums and single-family residential communities), retail, office, hospitality, industrial, mixed-use and specialty-use real estate.

Our investment focus includes originating or acquiring loans backed by single assets or portfolios of assets that typically have (i) an investment hold size of approximately $15-100 million, secured by CRE assets, including transitional or construction projects, across diverse property types, (ii) a duration of approximately 2-5 years, (iii) interest rates that are determined periodically on the basis of a floating base lending rate (e.g., Secured Overnight Financing Rate ("SOFR")) plus a credit spread, (iv) a loan-to-value ("LTV") ratio of no greater than approximately 75% on an individual investment basis and (v) no more than approximately 75% LTV across the portfolio, in each case, at the time of origination or acquisition, and are led by experienced borrowers and well-capitalized sponsors with high quality business plans. Our loans typically feature origination fees and/or exit fees. We target a portfolio net internal rate of return ("IRR") in the low-teens, which we believe may increase to the mid-teens after including total interest and other revenue from the portfolio, including loans funded from drawing on our leverage, net of our interest expense from our portfolio lenders. We are also targeting a near to mid-term target capitalization of one-third equity, one-third secured debt availability and one-third unsecured debt. We do not expect to be fully drawn on our secured debt availability and, as a result, we are targeting an expected leverage ratio of 1.5:1 debt-to-equity.

In July 2024, we separated from Advanced Flower Capital Inc. ("AFC") through a spin-off transaction (the "Spin-Off"). The separation was effected by the transfer of AFC's commercial real estate portfolio from AFC to us, and the distribution of all of the outstanding shares of our common stock to all of AFC's stockholders of record (the "Distribution") as of the close of business on July 8, 2024 (the "Record Date"). As a result of the Spin-Off, we are now an independent, public company trading under the symbol "SUNS" on The Nasdaq Stock Market ("Nasdaq").

We seek to generate strong risk-adjusted returns by originating and investing in CRE assets located in the Southern U.S., including ground-up development and recapitalization transactions, with an emphasis on direct origination of loans with borrowers. Returns are anticipated to be generated through a combination of current and/or accrued interest payments, origination and exit fees, minimum multiple-of-capital payments and extension and other fees. We intend to primarily invest in senior mortgage loans, mezzanine loans, B-notes, CMBS and debt-like preferred equity securities across CRE asset classes.

We seek to lend to experienced borrowers in order to: (i) finance acquisitions, (ii) refinance existing indebtedness, (iii) fund value-add and transitional business plans, or (iv) provide portfolio-level liquidity solutions directly or via purchases of existing loans. We expect that our investments will typically have the following characteristics:
•target deal size of $15 million to $250 million; •investment hold size of $15 million to $100 million;
•secured by CRE assets, including transitional or construction projects, across diverse property types;
•located primarily within markets in the Southern U.S. benefiting from economic tailwinds with growth potential;

•no more than approximately 75% LTV on an individual investment basis and no more than approximately 75% LTV across the portfolio, in each case, at the time of origination or acquisition;

headings: Risks Related to Our Business and Growth Strategy
Competition for the capital investments that we make may reduce the return of these investments, which could adversely affect our operating results and financial condition.
If we are unable to successfully integrate new CRE loans and manage our growth, our results of operations and financial condition may suffer.
We will allocate our cash on hand and the proceeds of our financing activities without input from our shareholders.
Our investments' lack of liquidity may adversely affect our business.
Our existing portfolio is, and our future portfolio may be, concentrated in a limited number of investments, which subjects us to an increased risk of significant loss if any asset declines in value.
Our portfolio is concentrated in the Southern U.S., and we will be subject to economic and other risks of doing business in those geographic markets.
The commercial mortgage loans we intend to originate and acquire are subject to the ability of the commercial property owner to generate net income from operating the property.

In the event of borrower distress or a default, we may lack the liquidity necessary to protect our investment or avoid a corresponding default on any obligations we may have in connection with our own financing.
We may need to foreclose on certain of the loans we originate or acquire, which could result in losses that materially and adversely affect us.
Construction loans involve an increased risk of loss.
Risks of cost overruns and non-completion of the construction or renovation of the properties underlying loans we originate or acquire could materially and adversely affect us.
Investments we may make in CMBS may be subject to losses.

We may not control the special servicing of the mortgage loans included in the CMBS in which we invest, and, in such cases, the special servicer may take actions that could adversely affect our interests.
The B-notes that we may acquire may be subject to additional risks related to the privately negotiated structure and terms of the transaction, which may result in losses to us.
If our Manager overestimates the yields or incorrectly prices the risks of our investments, we may experience losses.
Some of our investments may be recorded at fair value and, as a result, there will be uncertainty as to the value of these investments.
Interest rate fluctuations could increase our financing costs, which could lead to a significant decrease in our results of operations, cash flows and the market value of our investments.

We were recently formed and have limited operating history, and may not be able to operate our business successfully or to generate sufficient revenue to make or sustain distributions to our shareholders.
We face risks associated with the deployment of our capital.
Monetary policy actions by the United States Federal Reserve could adversely impact both our borrowers and our financial condition.
Declines in market prices and liquidity in the capital markets can result in significant net unrealized losses of our portfolio, which in turn would reduce our book value.
Provisions for loan losses are difficult to estimate.
The investments and other assets we will acquire may be subject to impairment charges, and we may experience a decline in the fair value of our assets.
Any credit ratings assigned to our investments will be subject to ongoing evaluations and revisions, and we cannot assure you that those ratings will not be downgraded.
A prolonged economic slowdown, a lengthy or severe recession or declining real estate values could impair our investments and harm our operating results.
Investments in non-conforming and non-investment grade rated investments involve an increased risk of default and loss.
Investments in subordinated mortgage interests, mezzanine loans and other assets that are subordinated or otherwise junior in a borrower's capital structure may expose us to greater risk of loss.
We may be subject to additional risks associated with CRE loan participations.
paragraphs: Set forth below are the risks that we believe are material to our business. Any of these risks could significantly and adversely affect our business, financial condition and results of operations. You should carefully consider the risks described below, together with the other information included in this Annual Report, including the information contained under the caption "Special Note Regarding Forward-Looking Statements".

Our business and our ability to execute our strategy are subject to many risks. Before making a decision to invest in our common stock, you should carefully consider all of the risks and uncertainties described in the risks set forth below. These risks include, but are not limited to, the following:
•Competition for the capital investments that we make may reduce the return of these investments, which could adversely affect our operating results and financial condition.
•Our investments' lack of liquidity may adversely affect our business.

•Our existing portfolio is, and our future portfolio may be, concentrated in a limited number of investments, which subjects us to an increased risk of significant loss if any asset declines in value.

•In the event of borrower distress or a default, we may lack the liquidity necessary to protect our investment or avoid a corresponding default on any obligations we may have in connection with our own financing.

paragraphs: SUNS is a Maryland corporation that was formed on August 28, 2023 and that made its first investment in January 2024. We are a real estate focused debt fund, actively pursuing opportunities to finance transitional commercial real estate projects located across the Southern U.S. We are an integral part of the platform of affiliated asset managers under TCG.

In July 2024, we separated from Advanced Flower Capital Inc. ("AFC") through a spin-off transaction (the "Spin-Off"). The separation was effected by the transfer of AFC's commercial real estate portfolio to us and the distribution of all of the outstanding shares of our common stock to all of AFC's stockholders of record as of the close of business on July 8, 2024. As a result of the Spin-Off, we are now an independent, public company trading under the symbol "SUNS" on Nasdaq.

Our focus is on originating and investing in secured CRE loans and providing capital to high-quality borrowers and sponsors with transitional business plans collateralized by CRE assets with opportunities for near-term value creation, as well as recapitalization opportunities. We intend to further diversify our investment portfolio, targeting investments in senior mortgage loans, mezzanine loans, B-notes, CMBS and debt-like preferred equity securities across CRE asset classes. We intend for our investment mix to include loans secured by high quality residential (including multi-family, condominiums and single-family residential communities), retail, office, hospitality, industrial, mixed-use and specialty-use real estate.

We are an externally managed Maryland corporation and elected to be taxed as a REIT under Section 856 of the Internal Revenue Code of 1986, as amended (the "Code"), commencing with our taxable year ended December 31, 2024. We believe our organization and current and proposed method of operation will enable us to qualify as a REIT. However, no assurances can be given that our beliefs or expectations will be fulfilled, since qualification as a REIT depends on our continuing to satisfy numerous asset, income, distribution and other tests, which in turn depends, in part, on our operating results and ability to obtain financing. We also intend to operate our business in a manner that will permit us to maintain our exemption from registration under the Investment Company Act.

We are an "emerging growth company," as defined in the Jumpstart Our Business Startups Act ("JOBS Act"), and we are eligible to take advantage of certain exemptions from various reporting requirements that are applicable to other public companies that are not "emerging growth companies" including, but not limited to, not being required to comply with the auditor attestation requirements of Section 404 of the Sarbanes-Oxley Act, reduced disclosure obligations regarding executive compensation in our periodic reports and proxy statements, and exemptions from the requirements of holding a non-binding advisory vote on executive compensation and shareholder approval of any golden parachute payments not previously approved. In addition, Section 107 of the JOBS Act provides that an "emerging growth company" can take advantage of the extended transition period provided in Section 7(a)(2)(B) of the Securities Act for complying with new or revised accounting standards. In other words, an "emerging growth company" can delay the adoption of certain accounting standards until those standards would otherwise apply to private companies. We have elected to take advantage of the extended transition period. As a result, we will not be subject to the same implementation timing for new or revised accounting standards as other public companies that are not emerging growth companies, which may make comparison of our financials to those of other public companies more difficult.

We could remain an "emerging growth company" until the earliest to occur of the following: (1) the last day of the fiscal year (a) following the fifth anniversary of the date of the first sale of our common stock pursuant to an effective registration statement under the Securities Act, (b) in which we have total annual revenue of at least $1.235 billion, or (c) in which we are deemed to be a large accelerated filer, which generally means the market value of our common equity that is held by non-affiliates exceeds $700 million as of the end of the prior fiscal year's second fiscal quarter; and (2) the date on which we have issued more than $1 billion in non-convertible debt securities during the prior three-year period.

除非文意另有要求，否則 "Company"、"SUNS"、"we"、"us" 或 "our" 皆指 Sunrise Realty Trust, Inc。

SUNS 為馬裏蘭州公司，於 2023 年 8 月 28 日成立，並已選擇以美國聯邦所得稅目的，被視為不動產投資信託，其可課稅年度為 2024 年 12 月 31 日，並於 2024 年 1 月進行首次投資。SUNS 是 Tannenbaum Capital Group（"TCG"）旗下相關資產經理平台的重要組成部分。我們由一支經驗豐富的商業不動產投資專業團隊領導，並由我們的外部經理 Sunrise Manager LLC（我們的 "Manager"）所支持，該經理與 TCG 平台其他追求類似或相關機會的資產經理共同合作，由 TCG 平台專業團隊提供的行銷、報告、法律及其他非投資支援服務所支援。我們與 TCG 之間的關係，使我們能透過商業不動產所有者、營運者及相關企業的強大關係網路，獲得投資機會，並擁有大量後臺人員協助貸款管理。

我們的重點在於發起並投資於有抵押的商業不動產（"CRE"）貸款，並提供資金給具有過渡性商業計畫的高品質借款人及發起人，其抵押物為 CRE 資產，並有近端價值創造的機會，以及資本結構重整的機會。SUNS 計畫進一步多元化其投資組合，目標為投資於高階抵押貸款、中階抵押貸款、B-貸款、商業抵押貸款支持證券（"CMBS"）及類似債務的優先權益證券，橫跨 CRE 資產類別。我們的投資組合將包含以高品質住宅（包括多戶住宅、公寓及單戶住宅社區）、零售、辦公室、旅館、工業、混合用途及特殊用途不動產為抵押物的貸款。

我們的投資重點包括發起或取得以單一資產或資產組合為抵押的貸款，通常具有（i）投資持有規模約為 15-100 百萬美元，以 CRE 資產為抵押，包括過渡性或建設中的項目，橫跨多樣化的不動產類型，（ii）貸款期限約為 2-5 年，（iii）利率根據浮動基準貸款利率（例如：secured overnight financing rate（"SOFR"））加上信用利差定期決定，（iv）貸款價值比（"LTV"）在個別投資上不超過約 75%，且（v）在投資組合上不超過約 75% 的 LTV，於發起或取得時，均由經驗豐富的借款人及資本充足的發起人領導，其商業計畫品質高。我們的貸款通常包含發起費用及/或退出費用。我們目標的投資組合淨內部收益率（"IRR"）為低 teens，我們相信在包含總利息及其他收入後，可能提高至 mid-teens，包括從動用我們槓桿資金所取得的貸款，扣除我們從投資組合貸款人所支付的利息費用。我們也目標近至中短期的資本結構為三分之一權益、三分之一有擔保債務可用性及三分之一無擔保債務。我們不預期會完全動用我們的有擔保債務可用性，因此我們目標的槓桿比率為 1.5:1 的債務對權益。

2024 年 7 月，我們透過 spin-off 交易（"Spin-Off"）與 Advanced Flower Capital Inc.（"AFC"）分拆。此分拆透過將 AFC 的商業不動產資產組合從 AFC 轉移至我們，並於 2024 年 7 月 8 日（"Record Date"）營業日結束時，將我們所有普通股股份發放給 AFC 的記錄股東（"Distribution"）完成。分拆後，我們成為一家獨立的上市公司，於 Nasdaq 股票市場（"Nasdaq"）以符號 "SUNS" 交易。
我們透過發起及投資位於美國南部的 CRE 資產，包括從零開始的開發及資本結構重整交易，並強調直接發起貸款給借款人，以產生強勁的風險調整後回報。回報預期透過現金及/或應計利息支付、發起及退出費用、最低倍數資本支付及延長及其他費用的組合產生。我們目標主要投資於高階抵押貸款、中階抵押貸款、B-貸款、CMBS 及類似債務的優先權益證券，橫跨 CRE 資產類別。
我們目標貸款給經驗豐富的借款人，以：（i）資助收購，（ii）重組現有債務，（iii）資助價值增加及過渡性商業計畫，或（iv）提供投資組合層級的流動性解決方案，直接或透過購買現有貸款。我們預期投資通常具有以下特徵：

paragraphs: SUNS 是一間馬裏蘭州公司，於 2023 年 8 月 28 日成立，並於 2024 年 1 月進行首次投資。我們是一家專注於不動產的債務基金，積極尋求機會資助位於美國南部各地的過渡性商業不動產項目。我們是 TCG 下屬聯屬資產管理公司的平台中不可或缺的一部分。
2024 年 7 月，我們透過分拆交易（"分拆"）與 Advanced Flower Capital Inc. ("AFC") 分離。分拆透過將 AFC 的商業不動產投資組合轉讓給我們，並於 2024 年 7 月 8 日營業日結束時，將我們所有流通股股份分發給 AFC 的記錄股東完成。分拆後，我們成為一家獨立的上市公司，於 Nasdaq 以 "SUNS" 編碼交易。

我們的重點在於發起並投資於有擔保的 CRE 貸款，並為具有過渡性商業計畫的高質量借款人及發起人提供資金，這些借款人及發起人以 CRE 資產為擔保，並有近端價值創造的機會，以及重組機會。我們有意進一步多元化投資組合，目標投資於高階房貸貸款、Mezzanine 貸款、B-Notes、CMBS 以及 CRE 資產類別中的債務類優先股證券。我們的投資組合將包括以高質量住宅（包括多單位住宅、公寓及單戶住宅社區）、零售、辦公室、旅館、工業、混合用途及特殊用途不動產為擔保的貸款。

我們是一間外部管理的馬裏蘭州公司，並已選擇根據 1986 年內部收入法典第 856 節（"法典"）作為 REIT 稅收。自 2024 年 12 月 31 日結算的財務年度起，我們相信我們的組織結構及目前與未來的運作方式將使我們符合 REIT 的條件。然而，無法保證我們的信念或預期會實現，因為符合 REIT 的條件取決於我們持續滿足多項資產、收入、分紅及其他測試，而這些測試部分取決於我們的營運表現及取得融資的能力。我們也意圖以一種方式運作業務，使我們能維持免於根據投資公司法進行註冊的豁免。

我們被視為根據 Jumpstart Our Business Startups Act ("JOBS Act") 定義的 "新興成長公司"，我們有資格利用某些豁免權，適用於其他非 "新興成長公司" 的公開公司，包括但不限於，不需遵守薩班斯-奧克斯利法案第 404 節的審計師認證要求、我們定期報告及股東說明書中關於高層薪酬的披露義務較少，以及免於進行非綁定建議投票以審議高層薪酬及股東批准任何未經批准的金色降落傘支付。此外，JOBS Act 的第 107 節規定，"新興成長公司" 可利用證券交易法第 7(a)(2)(B) 節提供的延長過渡期，以符合新或修正的會計標準。換句話說，"新興成長公司" 可延後採用某些會計標準，直到這些標準原本適用於私人公司。我們已選擇利用延長過渡期。因此，我們不會受到與其他非新興成長公司的公開公司相同的會計標準實施時間限制，這可能使我們的財務資料與其他公開公司的比較變得困難。

我們可能持續作為 "新興成長公司" 直到以下情況最早發生為止：(1) 財務年度最後一天 (a) 距離我們首次根據證券交易法有效註冊聲明下發行普通股的日期屆滿五年後，(b) 我們總年營收至少為 1.235 十億美元，或 (c) 我們被視為大型加速申報者，這通常意味著在上一個財務年度第二財務季度結束時，我們普通股的市場價值（由非關係方持有）超過 7 億美元；以及 (2) 我們在前三年期間發行超過 1 十億美元的不可轉換債務證券的日期。

headings: 與我們業務及成長策略相關的風險
我們所進行的資本投資可能因競爭而降低投資回報，這可能會對我們的營運成果與財務狀況造成不利影響。
若我們無法成功整合新進的 CRE 貸款並管理成長，我們的營運成果與財務狀況可能會受損。
我們將會將現金及融資活動所得資金分配使用，而無需股東的意見。
我們投資的流動性不足可能會對我們的業務造成不利影響。
我們現有投資組合已經，未來投資組合可能也會，集中於有限數量的投資，這會使我們面臨資產價值下跌時產生重大損失的風險增加。
我們的投資組合集中在美國南方地區，我們將會面臨在這些地理市場進行業務的經濟及其他風險。
本公司擬發放及取得之商業不動產貸款，其能否發放及取得，取決於商業不動產所有者能否自經營該不動產中產生淨收入。
若借款人遭遇財務困難或違約，本公司可能缺乏足夠流動性以保護投資或避免因本公司自身融資而產生之對應違約。
本公司可能需要對所發放或取得之貸款進行法拍，此舉可能導致損失，並對本公司造成重大且不利影響。
建設貸款涉及較高之損失風險。
本公司所發放或取得之貸款所涉及之不動產建設或翻修工程，若發生成本超支或無法完成，可能對本公司造成重大且不利影響。
本公司可能投資於商業不動產支持證券（CMBS），此類投資可能面臨損失風險。
本公司可能無法控制所投資之商業不動產支持證券（CMBS）中包含之抵押貸款之特別服務，且在該等情況下，特別服務機構可能採取對本公司權益造成不利影響之行動。
本公司可能取得之B級證券（B-notes）可能面臨與私下行事結構及交易條款相關之額外風險，此等風險可能導致本公司產生損失。
若本公司經理高估投資報酬率或錯誤評估投資風險，我們可能會遭遇損失。
部分投資可能以公允價值計入帳面，因此這些投資價值可能存在不確定性。
利率波動可能增加我們的融資成本，進而導致營業成果、現金流及投資市場價值顯著下降。
本公司近期才成立，營運歷史有限，可能無法成功經營業務或產生足夠收入以發放或維持對股東的分紅。
我們面臨資本運用的相關風險。
美國聯邦儲備系統的貨幣政策措施可能對我們的借款人及財務狀況產生不利影響。
資本市場價格下跌及流動性降低，可能導致我們投資組合產生重大未實現損失，進而降低本公司帳面價值。
貸款減損提列困難度高。
本公司所取得之投資及其它資產可能面臨減損費用，且本公司可能遭遇資產公允價值下降之情形。
任何針對本公司投資之信用評級將持續進行評估與修正，本公司無法保證這些評級不會被降級。
若總體經濟減速持續延長、經濟衰退時間過長或情況嚴重，或實質房地產價值下降，可能影響本公司之投資並損害營運成果。
投資於不符合標準及非投資等級評級之投資，涉及較高之違約與損失風險。
投資於次級房貸權益、中階貸款及其它在借款人資本結構中次級或其它較低順位之資產，可能使本公司面臨較高之損失風險。
本公司可能面臨與商業不動產貸款參與相關之額外風險。
paragraphs: 下列為我們認為對本公司業務具有重大影響的風險。上述任何風險都可能顯著且不利地影響本公司業務、財務狀況及營運成果。您應謹慎考量下列所描述的風險，並與本年度報告中包含的其他資訊一併考量，包括「特別提醒有關未來展望陳述」標題下所載的資訊。
本公司業務及執行策略的能力受到許多風險影響。在決定投資本公司普通股之前，您應謹慎考量下列所描述的所有風險與不確定性。這些風險包括但不限於以下內容：
•我們所進行的資本投資之競爭可能降低這些投資的回報，這可能會不利地影響本公司營運成果與財務狀況。
•我們投資之缺乏流動性可能不利地影響本公司業務。
•我們現有投資組合已集中於極少數的投資項目，未來投資組合亦可能集中於極少數的投資項目，這使我們面臨若任何資產價值下跌時，產生重大損失的風險增加。
•在借款人陷入財務困境或違約的情況下，我們可能缺乏足夠的流動性以保護我們的投資，或避免因我們自身融資而產生的對應違約。
